Hemorrhage is the medical term for bleeding. It most often refers to excessive bleeding. Hemorrhagic diseases are caused by bleeding, or they result in bleeding (hemorrhaging). Related topics include: Primary thrombocythemia (hemorrhagic thrombocythemia) Stroke Yellow fever Bleeding disorders Ebola fever Dengue hemorrhagic fever Vitamin K deficiency References Halstead SB.
